morning.caption:
Today is a Dog day 🐕 Pause on your animal.

Every day has an animal. Today's Dog meets the animal of the year you were born: Rabbit gets a best-friend day, Tiger and Horse a team day, Dragon a clash day. Born in Jan or early Feb? Use the animal before yours.

Your animal is your Season. The element of the day you were born is your Sky. Find both free at the link in bio.

evening.caption:
Sky found one small flame in the dark, and the whole garden began to glow 🕯️

Sky is the gentle Yin spirit, and when she reached for that little fire she became Yin Fire: the candle, the lamp in the window, the starlight that helps you find your way at night. Ding Fire doesn't roar like a bonfire. It is warm, steady and close, and it lights up whatever it is near. In people, it is the attentive, thoughtful side that notices how others feel, brings comfort into a dark moment and helps everyone see a little more clearly. One small light can be enough to change a whole night.

Who is the candle in your life, the one who brings warmth when things feel dark? Tag them below 👇
